messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: Elevated 5xx rate for tenant PioneerBio on dedicated pool rb-dedicated-74 — canary traffic started ~5m ago. Error rate 18% (threshold 2%).

maya (oncall): I'm on it. acknowledging page. what tag rolled?

liam (serving): looks like `v2026.03.10-canary` was pushed into canary slice ~10:12UTC. previous stable is `v2026.02.27-stable`.

maya (oncall): @liam can you confirm scope — is this affecting only canary traffic or bleeding to stable?

liam (serving): only canary routing policies. Telemetry shows error spikes on PioneerBio tenant requests routed to lb-74-canary instances. No cross-tenant spill seen in metrics yet.

pete (sre): logs from the canary pods show `OutOfMemoryError` in the transformer worker during long context requests. sample:```2026-03-12T10:17:03Z runner ERROR oom while allocating 1.2GB```

maya (oncall): ok isolate plan: 1) pause canary traffic for PioneerBio, 2) pin PioneerBio to previous artifact, 3) roll forward to a safe variant later. Agree?

liam (serving): agree. I can run the pin. recommend also marking the tenant isolated in the routing layer to prevent further canary routing fallback.

ops-runbooks: Recommended command to pin artifact: ```redwoodctl rollout pin --tenant pioneerbio --pool rb-dedicated-74 --artifact v2026.02.27-stable --reason "canary oom"```

maya (oncall): @deploy-bot please hold canary slice for PioneerBio now.

deploy-bot: Received request: hold-canary tenant=pioneerbio pool=rb-dedicated-74. Executing...

deploy-bot: Hold complete. Canary routing for pioneerbio suspended (slice: canary).

liam (serving): Running pin now, will run in read-only then perform the actual pin.

liam (serving): Command: `redwoodctl rollout pin --tenant pioneerbio --pool rb-dedicated-74 --artifact v2026.02.27-stable`

deploy-bot: Pin command accepted. Starting pin operation. Progress: 0/4 hosts pinned.

pete (sre): adding a temporary route to divert new PioneerBio requests to dedicated stable instances: `route set --tenant pioneerbio --pool rb-dedicated-74 --variant stable --priority 100`

liam (serving): Pin progress update: 2/4 hosts pinned, config sync ok.

maya (oncall): customer impact? Has PioneerBio reported anything? SE channel?

liam (serving): PioneerBio reports intermittent 503s from their side; they opened a support ticket at 10:20UTC. I pinged their engineering lead to say we're performing a rapid rollback.

maya (oncall): good. I'll post a short status update to the enterprise status thread and the account team.

ops-runbooks: Note: after pin complete, run `redwoodctl cache flush --tenant pioneerbio --targets kvcache` to clear any problematic KV prefixes.

liam (serving): Pin complete. All 4 hosts now pinned to `v2026.02.27-stable`.

deploy-bot: Pin operation finished successfully. Artifact pinned: v2026.02.27-stable for tenant pioneerbio on pool rb-dedicated-74.

pete (sre): flushing caches now.

pete (sre): cache flush complete. Verifying error rate...

liam (serving): error rate dropped to 0.6% over 3m window. Latency nominal. Looks stable.

maya (oncall): excellent. I'll close the active page but will keep monitoring for 30m. @sienna can you schedule a follow-up postmortem to understand memory regression and rollout gating?

sienna (platform-eng): on it. Will set up a triage meeting and collect reproducer steps. suspect model memory growth with new attention kernels — might need quantization profile changes.

maya (oncall): action items: 1) SRE to run heapdump on the canary artifact in isolated env (liam/pete). 2) Platform to examine compilation/kernel changes (sienna). 3) Notify account team + PioneerBio of completed rollback and next steps (maya). 4) Re-evaluate canary gating thresholds.

liam (serving): copying logs/artifact diff to /shared/incidents/pioneerbio/1777701234.

pete (sre): raising a follow-up high-sev ticket for postmortem.

maya (oncall): closing page as mitigated. leaving thread open for handoff to postmortem. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident mitigated. Pager closed by maya (oncall). Severity: S2. Duration: 27m.

sienna (platform-eng): I'll kick off the postmortem doc and invite liam/pete/maya. expected first readout in 48h.

maya (oncall): thanks all. ping me if we see new regressions.

liam (serving): thanks — will also block `v2026.03.10-canary` from auto-promote until we validate fix.

pete (sre): noted. adding temp rule to block auto-rollouts for rb-dedicated-74.
